value.synopsis: Police officers are targeted and killed by an unknown person. Thinking the suspect is related with the police force, they're keeping quiet about the situation. Though when officer Satou keiji is injured by this killer, Ran is the only eye wittiness. Suffering from traumatic shock, she loses her memory of everything in her life. As a result, the killer now knows that Ran has seen his/her face, he/she must get rid of the sole eye witness. Conan must find the murderer while protecting his identity.
